assets.prompt:
Create a photo_grid for a professional presentation slide.
Core idea: キャンペーンの基本情報・期間・規約を管理する抽象的な編集画面
Match this source-deck photographic character: high-key and bright, restrained color, crisp contrast, neutral color temperature, moderate visual detail.
Visual tone: brightness match_source; saturation restrained; contrast soft_to_medium.
Composition: low-to-medium background complexity, medium subject scale, negative space on none when applicable.
Keep the primary subject clearly readable after a presentation-slot crop.
No embedded words, labels, logos, watermarks, UI text, charts, or typography.
The image must feel editorial and specific rather than generic stock photography.
Avoid: generic_stock_photo, busy_background, random_style_switch, image_with_embedded_text, filler_visual.
